title: Entry Word Followed by Lowercase Definition

illustrates.quote: d. Leave two blank cells between the entry-word segment and the definition segment when it is not followed by punctuation, capitalization, or enclosure symbols.

items.def: a word formed by using the initial letters of other words: radar “*radio* *detecting* *and* *ranging*”

print.printFeatures: Bold entry word; bold word within the definition; italicized phrase within parentheses in the definition.

braille.notes: Lines start at cell 1, with runovers at cell 3 (1-3 dictionary format). Two blank spaces separate the entry word 'acronym' from the definition.
